UN Warns of El Niño Impacts: Disease, Hunger, Extreme Heat

The United Nations has issued a warning regarding the impacts of El Niño, citing concerns about increased disease, hunger, and extreme heat. Separately, ocean temperatures have recorded 100 consecutive days of extreme heat, with reports suggesting El Niño is on track to break historical records.
